ideas.title: Following the Money in the Georgia Election Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial transactions and potential corruption surrounding the 2020 presidential election in Georgia.
questions: What financial transactions are being investigated?
Are there any connections to other corruption cases?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money is crucial in uncovering potential corruption. This story could reveal significant insights into the investigation and potential wrongdoing.
